| WORK-002 | Moved boundary or mechanism: The lead time is whole months: a period's job is created once the run's UTC calendar date reaches its start less the lead time. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| WORK-002 | Moved boundary or mechanism: The scheduler is an hourly Cron Trigger (minute 17, UTC; `rer dev` runs it; deploys register it) plus Run now; each run creates, in order, every period through the horizon not yet held (generated, claimed or skipped), so restarts repeat nothing and runs after downtime or a pause catch up. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| CRM-003 | Moved boundary or mechanism: A preparer sees only the jobs they may read (ACCESS-001), and client-wide records and exports only reach reviewers and the principal. | BASE-ROLE-001 | none | moved |

| CRM-005 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Spam checks are a honeypot, an installation-signed single-use form token valid from 3 seconds through 24 hours after issue, and at most five accepted submissions per connection in a rolling hour. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| CRM-005 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Rate-limit IPs are kept only as installation-keyed digests with one-hour expiry, excluded from archives and cleared on accepted submissions and the hourly trigger; raw IPs are never stored. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| SIGN-002 | Moved boundary or mechanism: A staff representative is named as a signer, receives no portal link, and signs with the same consent and intent at `/signatures/:id/staff-sign` in their own authenticated session (the session id stands in for the portal link on the certificate); they need no attestation. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| AUTHZ-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: new capabilities, record kinds and doors retain native authority, revocation, audit and portability/erasure integrity; supply the named public-door activation evidence in BASE-001 before shipping. | D-1 | none | moved |
| WORK-006 | Moved boundary or mechanism: a board card or plan move is a WORK-007 status change recorded in the job's history, so AUTOMATE-001's status triggers fire on it as on any other move; WORK-006 is done for every capability that exists today. | changelog | none | moved |
| WORK-007 | Moved boundary or mechanism: AUTOMATE-001 status triggers and set-status actions, WORK-006 plans and boards, REPORT-001 status reports and the MIGRATE-001 Karbon import carry WORK-007's status model in their own text and acceptance; WORK-007 is done for every capability that exists today. | changelog | none | moved |
| PORTAL-005 | Moved boundary or mechanism: One shared catalog (`src/i18n`) supplies every client-facing string, so the portal page and its progress, requests, shared files, messages, to-dos, tasks, organizers, signature requests, deliverables and shared logins, the invoice page, the request, organizer-invitation, deliverable, signature, invoice and invoice-reminder emails, the marketing footer and the marketing unsubscribe page read in the contact's language, with the page language attribute, dates and amounts following it. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| PORTAL-005 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Client flows are held to WCAG 2.2 AA by an automated axe-core scan of the Spanish portal page (with its organizer, signature, upload and shared-login panels) at 1440 and 390 and of the unsubscribe page, with a skip link, labelled controls, a visible keyboard focus indicator and landmark headings. | BASE-ACCESSIBILITY-001 | none | moved |
| SEARCH-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: SEARCH-001 is done for every capability that exists today. | changelog | none | moved |

| CAPACITY-003 | Moved boundary or mechanism: CAPACITY-003 is done for every capability that exists today. | changelog | none | moved |
| VAULT-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: credentials are AES-GCM ciphertext under the firm's vault key, derived from the installation's own VAULT_KEY secret (never the session secret) and the firm's random salt; one installation is one firm, and without VAULT_KEY the vault refuses to store or reveal. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| VAULT-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Archives carry the ciphertext (default), readable only where the same VAULT_KEY is configured, or leave it out; either way a restored credential that cannot be opened says so. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| LEARN-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: the existing external-agent key reads live source-linked corrections, questions and missing-document patterns and prepares a structured improvement for the principal who owns that key; Blotter does not claim to have run a model. | changelog | none | moved |
| WORK-007 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Entering In review or Completed still requires the REVIEW-001 gates, and no sub-status can bypass them. Every status change records who made it, when, and the old and new status. Renaming a sub-status keeps history. Deleting a sub-status that jobs still use is refused until a previewed bulk reassignment moves those jobs to another permitted status. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| WORK-009 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Task start and due dates are whole days before or after the work's start or due date and are computed when read, so open tasks follow every change to the job's due date or people; completing a task records its completer and time and keeps the owner and dates it had then. A task may be assigned by name to any active practice member or the principal; that person can then read the job and act on their own tasks (ACCESS-001). A task that needs an attachment completes only with one. A client-facing task shows only its name, due date and done state on the client's link; PORTAL-003 inherits client-facing tasks before it ships. Until WORK-006 ships, a person's weekly plan for a Monday-to-Sunday week lists their open tasks due in or before that week or with no due date, and their open jobs as preparer, reviewer or manager due in or before it; WORK-006 inherits tasks before it ships. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| MSG-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Templates have categories and search, and only permitted roles can edit firm templates. Until a second editing role exists, only the principal creates, edits and deletes firm templates. The contact first name is the first word of the contact's recorded name until CRM-001 stores names in parts; the work type is the engagement template's name until WORK-007; the invoice amount and due date stay unresolved, so sending is refused, until BILL-002 issues invoices; the portal link is created only when the message is sent. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| PORTAL-005 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Client flows meet WCAG 2.2 AA. | BASE-ACCESSIBILITY-001 | none | moved |
| TIME-004 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Staff-paid expenses are owed back to that person at cost, and the principal records each reimbursement. Until BILL-002 issues invoice documents, an expense's invoice line is its line in the reviewed billing export, reserved once; BILL-002 inherits approved billable expenses as invoice lines before it ships. Until BILL-003 ships, WIP is the value of everything ready to bill, and a job's profitability is its margin before staff cost: fixed fee, approved billable time (TIME-001) and its adjustments and approved billable expense charges, less the cost of every approved expense, billable or not; BILL-003 keeps expenses in its WIP and profitability. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| ACCESS-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Every private handler checks the native session/role and assigned-job visibility; writes recheck authority atomically. | BASE-ROLE-001 | none | moved |
| ACCESS-004 | Moved boundary or mechanism: An enrollment report gives evidence for the firm's WISP and the FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314.4(c)(5)); it records enrollment facts and never claims certification. Every session, whenever it began, must pass its own second-factor check before any practice data, and a person who has enrolled a factor is asked for it at every new session even while the policy is off. Until a second owner role exists, the principal recovers their own factor with a recovery code. Until ACCESS-005 or ACCESS-003 passes a provider's MFA assertion to Blotter, every federated session is treated as lacking one and is challenged for a Blotter factor. Today's sessions are browser sign-in sessions, whatever the method, and all pass the same check; MOBILE-001 apps and API-002 person-created sessions inherit it before they ship. Session lifetime (from sign-in) and idle timeout (since the session's last request) are whole minutes set by the principal; reaching either ends the session. Five incorrect codes within 15 minutes pause verification for 15 minutes. | docs/contract/mechanism.md | none | moved |
| BASE-001 | Moved boundary or mechanism: Retain Base native operator authentication, mail transport, import-kit preview/journal/undo and portability/erasure integrity. | BASE-DATA-001 | none | moved |
